source.label: Tekken 2 move and combo archive
source.note: Commands use 1/2/3/4 notation. Land the starting attack before continuing a route. Some endings hit grounded opponents and depend on their recovery; timing, range and opponent size matter. 10 hit combos are preset strings, not guaranteed juggles.
